briefdescription.para: Adaptive sub-stepper for semi-explicit (forward-Euler-based) return-mapping algorithms.

detaileddescription.para: Analogous to AdaptiveSubstepper but adapted for explicit integration schemes. Error estimation is performed by Richardson extrapolation between a full-step and two half-steps.

materialTangentSize
Size of the material tangent matrix.
nIntegrationDependentStateVars
Number of integration-dependent state variables.
Reference: Matthias Neuner (2016), developed within the DK-CIM collaboration.
